details: New audit-source schema dispatches only through authenticated META_PIPELINE_AUDIT preservation; existing audit CC append and original FULL renderer paths remain separate.
Only a validated sourceOnly audit context omits a new difficulty registration; its original FULL audit history is replayed by the new loader.
Rebind-prior exclusion retains audit preservation, audit CC append and original renderer exclusions.
Output digests force inclusion of renderer, source-review, audit-source, original-renderer, audit-CC and approved-renderer sidecars; current existing-file equality guards remain.
All own M2 renderer/provider opt-ins and new retained-scope/rationale opt-ins coexist.
retainedScopeParent and nativeSourceReview each require exactly one parent proof; lineage plus sourceReview still selects the durable source binding.
The registrar rejects simultaneous nativeSourceReview and retainedScopeParent and uses each dedicated validator.
isAuditPreservation recognizes the legacy and new audit-source type, while explicit audit CC append, FINAL_QA subset, recovery, original-renderer and approved-renderer paths remain.
Subset/recovery/original renderer retain PARTIAL_UIDS requirement. Values stay empty and all preservation requests reach the official registrar replay and Consumer.
Registry mutation remains allowed only for the separately exact audited CC append descriptor in this preservation branch.
historicalAuditReceipt is retained for the explicitly typed audit CC append prior.
auditSourceAncestor is additionally allowed only for exact priorCommit/raw SHA, original FULL audit receipt/source/count/request snapshot shape.
Ordinary ancestor refs continue recursive live fixed-input staging; stopping historical staging does not skip the official registrar authority replay.
BUILDER_SHA retains current-renderer negative v1/v2, M2 continuity/imported continuity and existing helpers, and adds metadata-hold plus its replay helper.
holdEvidenceDigests adds metadataTransportEvidence while retaining all existing fields and currentRendererHold directFields.
Any metadata continuation claim forces fresh evaluation instead of reusing the previous file result; the other input hash and negative obligations remain.

limitations: Review covers the named merge-union boundaries and their directly called dispatches, not a complete re-audit of all newly merged upstream modules.
Reviewer ran no syntax, unit, registration, build, Consumer, clone or remote commands.
Q17 exact459e continuity review is a separate report; this staged preview predates that integration.
Owner compact row choices and data review were not repeated by this code-only reviewer.
Latest merged-head tests, full Consumer and remote CI remain required owner gates.
